title: Threshold staircases and the Poisson–Gaussian bridge
summary: Joint Poisson–Gaussian limits for conditioned run counts, with an autoregressive Gaussian target and independent normal innovations. Quantitative results give local Poisson probabilities, a Gaussian distribution-function bound, moderate deviations, and relative local or tail estimates for the multiplicative source under the stated information budgets. The whole integer-level point process has locally finite but infinite total mass; its complete upper-half laws, conditioning on a fixed count and extreme phases are included.
